description.p: Chippy shows your Dreame robot vacuum’s map with its rooms and where the robot is while it cleans, lets you pick the rooms to clean and start, pause or send the robot home. Sign in once with your Xiaomi account, by password or by scanning a QR code with the Xiaomi Home app; the session is kept in the GNOME keyring.
Edit the robot’s map too: draw no-go and no-mop zones and virtual walls, rename rooms, give each room its own suction, mopping and passes, set the cleaning order, and merge or split rooms.

Chippy can keep watching in the background and notify you when cleaning finishes or the robot needs help, and an optional top-bar extension puts the robot’s status and controls one click away. It is tested with the Dreame r2209 (Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X10); other Dreame models are experimental.
The first release of Chippy, a GNOME app for Dreame robot vacuums.

ul.li: Live map: rooms with their areas, the dock, and the robot’s position and route while it cleans
Room cleaning: pick rooms on the map or in the list, choose suction and mopping, then start, pause, stop, send the robot home or make it play a sound
Map editor: no-go and no-mop zones, virtual walls, room names, per-room suction, mopping and passes, cleaning order, and room merge and split, all saved to the robot
Sign in with your Xiaomi password, or by scanning a QR code with the Xiaomi Home app for accounts that use Google, Facebook or Apple; robots shared with you are found too
Background alerts when a run finishes or the robot needs help, with readable names for Dreame fault codes
An optional GNOME Shell extension (GNOME 50 and 51) with status and quick controls in the top bar
